notes.title: RARE DIVIOS DEFEATED
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/3bb9b7163e84849a50600b7a3ff712694994b117.jpg[/img]

[b]CONGRATULATIONS HEROES!!!
[/b]
Thanks to the combined power of crossplay, we are happy to announce that over 10,000 Rare Divios have been defeated within the month of April. You fought hard and came out victorious.

Now for the loot…

All players who have participated will receive Mixtape's Quickfire in their inbox within 48 hours of the end of the event.

We would like to thank all who participated in the event, we hope you enjoyed hunting down the BIG GREEN MEANIES.

[i]Please stay to tuned for updates for the next event we have planned. Good luck and Happy Hunting.[/i]

notes.title: Help the Community hunt 10,000 Rare Divio.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/a56b779a5238b3b386c6e3ebc3f26df101ca8bf6.jpg[/img]

Hey Heroes,

In celebration of Spring, we are here to bring you a new challenge. In the spirit of the season, we are hunting the BIG GREEN MEANIES, 😈 that’s right folks we are hunt down Rare Divio! Once the community has destroyed 10,000 Rare Divio, Mixtape's Quickfire will be unlocked for those Heroes who have participated through April 30th.

THERE ARE SO MANY DIVIO CLONES, HELP!

One thing to keep in mind for this challenge, when initial engaging in combat with the Rare Divio is their clones will start to stack up quickly. If left unchecked they will outnumber you and end your adventure before it really begins. Try to target the Rare Divio himself instead of working through the clones to get to the big guy.

If the challenge is completed by April 30th, the full CrossPlay community will be awarded Mixtape’s QuickFire. The timer is ticking so let’s get out there and get to work!

notes.title: Dungeon Maker, Loot & Progression Overhaul, Mixer Interactive, and Analytics, Oh My!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/231e76c5cde6aeeb2b10223b2e09526c0731cc88.jpg[/img]
Since Early Access launched, we’ve watched you defeat the Champion Trial, suffer to the might of Toppers, and dab on the haters with Mixtape. Take a look at these statistics we’ve put together since our launch. Thank you all for your suggestions, ideas, bug reports, and great videos.

Now for the good stuff. Meet the largest update to Next Up Hero yet! Let’s take a look inside:

[*][b]Dungeon Maker Mode[/b]: Craft and create a diabolical venture, and challenge the community to defeat it! 100 levels of darkness? Make it happen! Wager against the community. If you dungeon is defeated in one-live, a rare loot reward goes to the player. If no one can defeat the dungeon, the dungeon maker gets the loot!

We’ve heard you when it comes to levels. You love RPG mode, but Don’t Be Greedy is your worst nightmare. So we thought OK, what if we could give you 100 levels of RPG mode, wouldn’t that be epic? Then Nitin enabled the ability to setup and craft ventures with all of the modes, so we have a proper system in place to let you be the DM of your dreams (or nightmares).

Even better, now we’ll be able to highlight the deadliest ventures from the community. If you have a venture that’s really epic, shoot a note to @aspyrbash in Discord, so we can move it to the Featured Section.

[*][b]Equipment drops, slots and progression overhaul[/b]: 2 ability slots, 3 armor slots, and an individual leveling system per character

Y’all got to Max level really quickly as you worked through the story, but you’ve frequently requested more reasons to try other characters, and per-character leveling. We’ve now added a per-character leveling system that will unlock 3 equipment slots, as well as 2 ability slots. 

Prestiging a character will unlock the leveling system now, and you’ll have a more clear view of which stats are being Min-Maxed. Did I mention how equipment changes your stats? Because it does!

Artifacts have been re-purposed from one-time use objects into permanent loot drops. The harder the venture, the rarer and more valuable the loot. The rarest loot? That’s reserved for the deadliest dungeons in Dungeon Maker Mode!

[*][b]Mixer Interactive[/b]: Enable Interactive while streaming on Mixer, and invite your friends to play alongside you via the browser. Will they control your echo army, leading you to victory? Or will they summon shadows to destroy you?

The Mixer community has welcomed Next Up Hero with open arms since day one. And we’ve had many requests to use Mixer Interactive, so we did. Mixer Interactive is now enabled on Next Up Hero.

Pit your friends and audience against each other in a chaotic brawl between the Commander and the Dirge. Echoes will follow your Commander’s lead, fighting and focusing on the enemies of their choice. Dirge will buff the enemies, as well as put you in harm’s way with Stuns, Freezes, and Slows.

And everyone else needs to pick a side. Cheer for your favorite streamer, summoning Echoes to assist them. Or cheer Dirge, and summon Shadows to thwart their progress.

[*][b]UI Improvements, Bug Fixes, & More[/b]: We’ve implemented a lot of user feedback to create a buttery smooth experience. 

Of course, while we worked on these new features, we’ve gone in and fixed tons of bugs, updated the UI, and polished the experience.
[/list]
The full patch notes are available in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/667810/discussions/0/1634111706739411169/]this thread.[/url]

[b]Feedback NEEDED! TAKE THE SURVEY!!![/b]
For the latest update, we’ve changed the attack system to allow Auto-Attack (Just hold down the Mouse or Trigger). We know this is a major change, so we’ve put together a short survey to collect your thoughts.

Play around with a few different heroes, and revisit some that you didn’t connect with before. [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/NUHAA]Then take this survey[/url] so we can really determine if this is the right feel for the game.

notes.title: Next Up Hero adds a new Hero and revamps Co-op!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Early Access week 5 Heroes! We've got some big surprises this week!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/8a9ccd2ddefc14a522ab5b29b670ca05b45bc700.jpg[/img]
[h1]Co-op Revamped![/h1]
We’ve heard your thoughts on Echo-op, and we’ve revamped the system! This system is new, and we wanted to push it out to the community as soon as possible, so there will be bugs. Please let us know of any issues via the NUH [url=discord.gg/NextUpHero] Discord Channel[/url] or in this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/667810/discussions/0/1699416432429716249/]thread[/url]

[h1]Meet Jett[/h1]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/acf21e597ae2dcc2bd33753747404b73a1c3969a.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/e6575cf8aa1a0ab572b6ef6ed5c1426734822f77.png[/img][/url]
For completing the Champion Trial, you’ve been awarded a new Hero, Jett! He dashes, he teleports, he has elemental buffs! Congratulations to our great community of Heroes for banding together and proving yourselves true Champions!

But that’s not all, there’s a new ancient, tuning, bug fixes, and much more! Read the full patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/667810/discussions/0/1634111706739411169/]here[/url].

[h1]Community Challenge: Streamer Thursday[/h1]
This week, I want all of us to join together on Thursday @ 4:00 PM EST/1:00 PM PST. Everyone get together and STREAM! Let’s get Next Up Hero rising through the ranks of Twitch, Mixer, & YouTube.

If you’re new to streaming, just try using the streamer that’s integrated with the game launcher! All you have to do is click the Broadcast Button (Camera to the left of Play), then link your Twitch account. If you have questions, ask!

[h1]Meet the Aspyr Community Team LIVE on Mixer[/h1]
Additionally, we’ll be kicking off our first stream on Mixer.com/AspyrMedia @ 4:00 PM EST on Thursday as well. If you’re not streaming, tune in!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/acf21e597ae2dcc2bd33753747404b73a1c3969a.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/e6575cf8aa1a0ab572b6ef6ed5c1426734822f77.png[/img][/url]
For completing the Champion Trial, you’ve been awarded a new Hero, Jett! He dashes, he teleports, he has elemental buffs! Congratulations to our great community of Heroes for banding together and proving yourselves true Champions!

But that’s not all, there’s a new ancient, tuning, bug fixes, and much more! Read the full patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/667810/discussions/0/1634111706739411169/]here[/url].

[h1]Community Challenge: Streamer Thursday[/h1]
This week, I want all of us to join together on Thursday @ 4:00 PM EST/1:00 PM PST. Everyone get together and STREAM! Let’s get Next Up Hero rising through the ranks of Twitch, Mixer, & YouTube.

If you’re new to streaming, just try using the streamer that’s integrated with the game launcher! All you have to do is click the Broadcast Button (Camera to the left of Play), then link your Twitch account. If you have questions, ask!

[h1]Meet the Aspyr Community Team LIVE on Mixer[/h1]
Additionally, we’ll be kicking off our first stream on Mixer.com/AspyrMedia @ 4:00 PM EST on Thursday as well. If you’re not streaming, tune in!

notes.title: Early Access Week 2!
notes.notes:
Heroes,

We’ve made it to Week 2 of Early Access! Last week we challenged you to post a boatload of screenshots (and we’ve seen some epic ones on the Hub). Here’s one of my favorites: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266025361
Additionally, we asked you to provide feedback on Spectator Mode, and you did! We’re taking all of your thoughts to heart and working through some ideas. More information on that soon!


This week we’d like to hear your thoughts on [b]the different play-styles in Next Up Hero[/b]. Do you have a favorite build? Do you prefer to get up close and personal? Or do you prefer to kite enemies on the outskirts of the level? Are you a hybrid player? We want to know!


Please let us know your thoughts about the different playstyles offered by the current melee, ranged, and hybrid characters in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/667810/discussions/0/1692659135919554867/]this thread[/url]


[h1]Week 2 Community Challenge[/h1]
Next Up Hero is all about community, so tell a friend about Next Up Hero. Invite them to watch the Join The Fight Trailer, and share their thoughts in the comments section below! How many views can we rake up in a week heroes?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jRI4pGDVH4

[h1]Join us on Steam and Discord[/h1]
Don't forget to join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/667810] Community Group on Steam[/url] and the Community Discord.GG/NextUpHero ! Come meet other players, and help each other complete ventures!


[h1]New Player? Checkout the Hero’s Guide![/h1]
If you’re new to Next Up Hero, we’ve put together the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1273524263]Hero’s Guide[/url] to kickstart your venture! Let us know what you’d like us to add to it!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Next Up Hero
notes.notes:
Next Up Hero is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

The Ceaseless Dirge has attacked! Fight as Legendary Heroes against tough-as-nails mechs and monsters. Every time you die, you leave behind an Echo who can be raised by the next player. The more heroes who die, the stronger we all become, until we win together. Are you a Hero? Good. You’re up next.
